text_block_list.text:
The intensive training period for the Umamusume.
At the summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're Durandal-chan's
Trainer, right? The one everyone's been talking about lately.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Word is spreading that an amazing Trainer has arrived.
Must be nice~ I wish they were my Trainer too~

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, here she comes, the celebrity we've all been hearing about.
All hail the King of a petty kingdom!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, just kidding, just kidding! But it really is amazing.
Taking on the NHK Mile Cup solely relying on your late kick.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That courage is fit for a king.
I can't afford to slack off either.

Though it's a bit embarrassing,
it still feels nice to have my name known.
With a light spring in my step, I reached my room, when...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: No, not particularly.
choice_data_list: I see. Want to come inside?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: No, there is no need for that.

Why did I even come when I have no real business here?
Feeling confused, I step into the room.
Thinking I might use the restroom, I stepped out into the hallway, when—

Thinking I'd go buy something to drink,
I stepped out into the hallway—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
choice_data_list: Wait, why are you still here?!
Wait, why are you still here?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—I am standing guard.
After all, my king has become a renowned figure now.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Just to be sure nothing goes wrong...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing! You free?
If so, how about having a few drinks in my room...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Hold on! Trespassing is not permitted.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This is the throne room.
If you seek an audience, you must show proper—
I haven't become such a VIP as to need a lookout. More importantly—
choice_data_list: Let's focus on training instead of guarding.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Understood.
I shall do so, however...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, just a little longer...
I must watch over my King...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: To think that my greatness has finally been recognized...
Rather than a sense of duty... she genuinely seemed to be enjoying it for herself.
